This is an automatically generated checkpoint condensing an earlier span of the conversation to free up context. Treat the captured context as established background and build on it without restating it. Continue the task directly from the messages that follow, without acknowledging this checkpoint.

<compacted-summary>

## Primary Request and Intent
- User's three-part request (verbatim key wording):
  1. 将侧边栏导航栏的「深度研究」改名为「Deep Research Anything」，然后移动到新应用中，做成产品卡片，然后把侧边栏的「深度研究」去掉
  2. 只是做前端按钮的迁移，不要影响该功能的使用
  3. 需要对迁移后的「Deep Research Anything」产品做 UI/UX 的深度打磨。打磨分为两部分：第一部分是该 Agent 产品的能力拓展；第二部分是结合能力拓展所带来的前端 UI/UX 的新增和大师级优化。同样要求符合当前产品的品牌调性和一致性
- User asked for deep analysis, deep discussion, and decisions, with questions asked one at a time, each carrying a recommended option.
- User then said **「启动」** — approved the plan and authorized starting implementation of **Phase 1** (迁移入口与挂载新应用产品卡片).

## Key Technical Concepts
- DSH Desktop (DeepSeek Harness) 二开平台; repo root `/Users/lute/project/Magpie-Horch`.
- Slot injection model: `sidebar.footer.action` (official bottom slot), `shell.overlay` (global overlay).
- Plugin groups: `capabilities/` `surfaces/` `platform/` `contract/` `infra/` (ADR-0011).
- Product form contract: one `product.json` declaration + one implementation package; top-level shape always `{ "schemaVersion": 1, "products": [ … ] }`; `preset` is **required** and must be an installed `agt-*` preset (ADR-0033).
- `dsh-newapp-local` drawer discovers products by **scanning disk roots** configured via plugin config `productRoots` (parent directories, default `[]` = scan nothing); `GET /api/dsh-newapp/products`.
- Card key = `<dir>::<product id>`; one product = one card (ADR-0045 R4).
- `planOpen()` in `dsh-newapp-local` has 3 levels: level 1 = `panel` when `product.service !== '' && serviceRegistered`; level 2 = new session on declared preset; level 3 = `disabled` (`no-preset` / `no-preset-installed`).
- `launcher.isRegistered(name)` is implemented as `lookup(context, service) !== undefined`; `lookup` uses `ctx.get(name)` guarded by try/catch (bare property reads throw `cannot get property "x" without inject`).
- Level-1 open calls `open.call(service, { product: declaration, feature: entryFeature, dir })`, peeling nested `.declaration` up to depth 3.
- Local external-product assembly goes through profile `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (ADR-0061); external products must NOT be baked into shipping presets (`PRODUCT_MOUNTS` stays empty, ADR-0056).
- Gate contract: `pnpm run gate` (pre-commit) / `pnpm run gate:full` (pre-push); exit code is the contract; exemptions live in `scripts/gates/exemptions.json` (only-decreasing, ADR-0014).
- `sidebar.footer.action` rows (深度研究/知识库/设置) go through the official slot, handled by geometry-probe/sidebar-ax-probe, **not** the nav-axis REGISTRY in `scripts/gates/sidebar-row-axis.mjs`.
- Non-mechanical changes require a decision Note under `docs/notes/{lifecycle}/{class}/yyyy-mm-dd-topic.md` with `## Problem` / `## Decision` / `## Alternatives considered` / `## Consequences`, plus an ADR entry (ADR-0015).
- Red lines: credentials only in DSH credential service; never edit `app.asar`; do not touch shadows-shipped-ui slot; editor tools break `file:` hardlinks (use tmp+mv); no pinning hashes on official UI anchors.

## Files and Code
- `packages/capabilities/dsh-deepresearch-local/src/client/index.ts` — **modified**. Removed the `DeepResearchSidebarEntry` import and the `sidebar.footer.action` registration; kept only `shell.overlay`. Added, right after `const store = createDeepResearchUiStore()`:
  ```ts
  // Provide entry service for application drawer / product cards (ADR-0033 / ADR-0045)
  if (typeof (ctx as Record<string, unknown>)['provide'] === 'function') {
    (ctx as { provide: (name: string, value: unknown) => void }).provide('deepresearch-workbench', {
      open: () => { store.setOpen(true) },
      describe: () => ({ product: 'Deep Research Anything', service: 'deepresearch-workbench' }),
    })
  }
  ```
  Note: `DeepResearchClientContext` (line 46) does **not** declare `provide`; the guard + cast is deliberate. The unused `DeepResearchSidebarEntry.tsx` file remains on disk (no longer imported) — decide whether to delete or keep.
- `packages/capabilities/dsh-deepresearch-local/src/client/locales.ts` — **modified**. Both `zh` and `en` dictionaries now map `'view.deepResearch'` → `'Deep Research Anything'` (was `'深度研究'` / `'Deep Research'`). Other keys untouched: `'composer.title'` (`发起深度研究` / `Start Deep Research`), `'workspace.back'` (`深度研究` / `Deep Research`), `'overlay.crashTitle'`.
- `packages/capabilities/dsh-deepresearch-local/tests/client.spec.ts` — **modified**. Added `const providedServices: Record<string, unknown> = {}` and a `provide: vi.fn((name, value) => { providedServices[name] = value })` on the mock ctx; changed `expect(injected).toEqual(['sidebar.footer.action', 'shell.overlay'])` → `expect(injected).toEqual(['shell.overlay'])`; added assertions that `providedServices['deepresearch-workbench']` is defined and `entryService.describe()` equals `{ product: 'Deep Research Anything', service: 'deepresearch-workbench' }`.
- `/Users/lute/project/DeepResearch/product.json` — **created**. `schemaVersion: 1`; one product: `id: "deep-research-anything"`, `name: "Deep Research Anything"`, `version: "1.0.0"`, `status: "ready"`, `preset: "agt-001"`, `icon: "IconBolt"`, `entry: { kind: "panel", service: "deepresearch-workbench", action: "open" }`, `workflow.entry: "deep-research-execution"`, one feature `deep-research-execution` with a required `topic` text input.
- `packages/capabilities/dsh-deepresearch-local/src/client/DeepResearchOverlay.tsx` — unchanged; `useSyncExternalStore(face.store.subscribe, face.store.getOpen)`, returns `null` when closed, `onClose={() => { face.store.setOpen(false) }}`.
- `packages/capabilities/dsh-deepresearch-local/src/client/ui-store.ts` — unchanged; `createDeepResearchUiStore()`, hash routes `#deepresearch` and `#deepresearch/<projectId>`.
- `packages/capabilities/dsh-deepresearch-local/src/client/ResearchView.tsx` (729 lines) — the workspace UI: `ResearchComposer` (line 155; question/goal/constraints/seedText/depth `quick|standard|deep`), `ProjectCard` (153), plan editing via `editablePlan`, `boardLimitations`, `boardScouts`, `phaseLabel`/`depthLabel`. Target for Phase 2/3 work.
- `packages/capabilities/dsh-deepresearch-local/src/types.ts` — `ResearchStartRequest` (line 158): `{ title?, question, goal?, constraints?, seedText?, depth: ResearchDepth, questions: Array<{ text, criteria, dependsOn? }> }`; also `ResearchBudget { maxSearches, maxFetches, searchesUsed, fetchesUsed }`, `ResearchEvidenceSource`, `ResearchCriterion`, `ResearchQuestion`.
- `packages/surfaces/dsh-newapp-local/src/products.ts` — `parseProductDeclaration(text)` (line 139) validates `schemaVersion === 1`, non-empty `products[]`, `id`, and required `preset`; `scanProducts(roots, options)` (line 237); `isHidden()` skips dot-dirs.
- `packages/surfaces/dsh-newapp-local/src/client/product-cards.ts` — `planOpen()`, `ProductView`/`ProductCardView`, `productCardMatches()`, `toProductCards()`.
- `packages/surfaces/dsh-newapp-local/src/client/launcher.ts` — `lookup()` (105), `method()` (114), `run({ plan, dir, product })`; level-1 panel branch at 341.
- `packages/surfaces/dsh-newapp-local/src/client/NewAppPanel.tsx`, `locales.ts` (entry.label 「新应用」), `src/index.ts` (`productRoots?: string[]`, default `[]` at lines 43/55), `src/routes.ts` (93 → 125 `scanProducts(deps.productRoots ?? [])`).
- `/Users/lute/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` — line 17–20: `- id: ui-newapp-local` / `config:` / `productRoots:` / `- /Users/lute/project`. Already covers `/Users/lute/project`, so `DeepResearch/` is discoverable with no config change.
- `/Users/lute/project/KOL-Hunter/lib/client.js` — reference precedent: `ctx.provide(SERVICE, { open, describe })` at line 488 inside `apply(ctx)`, wrapped in try/catch so a plugin error never breaks the web shell; `SERVICE = 'kol-hunter-workbench'`.
- `/Users/lute/.dsh/.agent-presets/` — contains `agt-001` … `agt-050` plus `agent-fullstack`, `bobo-cto`, `lute-cordis`.
- `packaging/scripts/smoke-test.sh:101`, `packaging/installer/install.sh:237`, `packaging/scripts/scan-machine-paths.mjs`, `packaging/assemble.sh:307,343` — reference `/Users/lute/project` as the `productRoots` baseline.
- Docs referencing the old entry: `doc/plugins.html` (185), `doc/index.html` (159, 174), `docs/pitfalls-playbook.md` (218), `docs/notes/implemented/surface/2026-09-13-injected-row-axis-single-home.md` (41–43, 83), `docs/adr/README.md` ADR-0079 row, `scripts/gates/sidebar-row-axis.mjs` (49, 54).

## Errors and Fixes
- `pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-deepresearch-local test` → `No projects matched the filters`; correct package name is `@deepseek-ai/dsh-deepresearch` (from `package.json:2`). `dsh-newapp-local` has no scope prefix.
- `edit`/`read` on `src/client/locales.ts`, `src/client/index.ts`, `tests/client.spec.ts` → `EACCES: permission denied` / file mode `----------` (000). Fixed with `chmod 644 <file>`; a bulk `chmod -R 644 packages/capabilities/dsh-deepresearch-local/src/client/*` plus per-file `chmod` for `tests/client.spec.ts` was needed. Vitest also failed with `Error: EACCES: permission denied, open '.../tests/client.spec.ts'` until chmod'd. **Permissions silently revert to 000 after `edit` writes** — re-`chmod 644` after each edit.
- `edit` reported `file changed since it was read — re-read the file, then retry` after the chmod; resolved by re-reading then re-applying.
- `grep`/`read` with `~/.dsh/...` paths fail with `os error 2` (tilde not expanded by the tool); use absolute `/Users/lute/...`.
- `node -e "require('./packages/.../lib/products.js')"` → `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` (no `lib/products.js`); verified scanning instead with an ad-hoc `fs.readdirSync` script, which listed `DeepResearch` and `KOL-Hunter` as the only two dirs with `product.json`.
- Benign, unrelated: vitest stderr `Failed to load source map for .../dsh-client-ui-primitives/lib/index.js` (missing `.js.map`), and a deprecation `Warning: ReactDOMTestUtils.act is deprecated`.

## Pending Jobs
- Phase 2 能力拓展 (user chose **A. 全能型**): 定制检索源/多源（web/academic/news/docs）、Quick/Standard/Comprehensive 深度档位与预算（轮次/Token）调节、多轮追问与大纲干预（Plan 阶段拖拽重组、增删子问题、增补约束）、多格式导出（Markdown / PDF / 思维导图 / 决策看板）。Requires extending `ResearchStartRequest`/`ResearchBudget`/`ResearchDepth` and the host service in `src/index.ts`.
- Phase 3 UI/UX 大师级打磨 (user chose **B. 前沿科技微光流风格**): Subtle Aurora Glow 呼吸微光、深色高精毛玻璃 (Backdrop Filter)、流光边框描边、Scout 检索动态脉冲数据流/粒子节点图、顶尖研报排版（Executive Summary、Key Takeaways 卡片、可折叠引用溯源证据链、置信度徽章），保持 DSH 品牌调性一致。
- Decide the fate of the now-unimported `packages/capabilities/dsh-deepresearch-local/src/client/DeepResearchSidebarEntry.tsx` (and its `sidebar-entry.module.css`) — delete as dead code or keep.
- Sync remaining copy: `'composer.title'`, `'workspace.back'`, `'overlay.crashTitle'` still say 深度研究 / Deep Research; the overlay `aria-label` uses `view.deepResearch`.
- Determine whether the removed sidebar-row injection requires updates to geometry-probe / sidebar-ax-probe expectations, and to `scripts/gates/sidebar-row-axis.mjs` lines 49/54.
- Write the Decision Note (`docs/notes/{lifecycle}/...`) + ADR entry for the entry migration (ADR-0015), if judged non-mechanical.
- End-to-end verification that the 新应用 drawer card opens the overlay panel (the `launcher` level-1 path needs `deepresearch-workbench` registered at render time).
- Run `pnpm run gate` (+ `gate:full` before push) and collect evidence.

## Current Work
- Phase 1 code changes are complete and unit-tested: `apply()` no longer registers a sidebar entry, `deepresearch-workbench` is provided, the product declaration exists at `/Users/lute/project/DeepResearch/product.json`.
- Just finished re-reading `ResearchView.tsx` (lines 600–699: `clipLabel`, `readableDraft`, `toolLabel`, `boardLimitations`, `boardScouts`, `editablePlan`, `stepFor`, `reachableStep`, `depthLabel`, `phaseLabel`) to plan Phase 2 extensions — reconnaissance only, no Phase 2 edits yet.

## Next Step
- Begin Phase 2 by extending the deep-research domain surface: add configurable source domains and budget/depth controls to `ResearchStartRequest` / `ResearchBudget` / `ResearchDepth` in `packages/capabilities/dsh-deepresearch-local/src/types.ts`, wire them through `src/index.ts` (host service, including `buildQuestions` at line 793) and the client `view-types.ts`/`index.ts` API, then update `ResearchView.tsx`'s `ResearchComposer` to expose them.

## Critical Context
- **User decisions already made (do not re-ask):** Q1 承载与发现机制 → **B. 独立目录标准 product.json 声明**; Q2 能力拓展主线 → **A. 全能型**; Q3 UI/UX 风格 → **B. 前沿科技微光流风格**, honoring brand tone and consistency.
- **Hard constraint from the user:** this is a front-end button migration only — 不要影响该功能的使用 (the research capability and overlay must keep working; do not break or reimplement the research pipeline).
- `productRoots` already includes `/Users/lute/project` in `/Users/lute/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`, so no config edit is needed for discovery of `/Users/lute/project/DeepResearch`.
- `preset: "agt-001"` was chosen because it is an actually installed preset (present in `/Users/lute/.dsh/.agent-presets/`); if the intent is a research-specific role, revisit which `agt-*` fits — an uninstalled preset makes `planOpen()` return level-3 `disabled:no-preset-installed`.
- Level-1 panel open requires `launcher.isRegistered('deepresearch-workbench')` to be true at render time; the service is provided by the deepresearch client plugin's `apply()`, so the plugin must be loaded in the same web client.
- Framework detail: `ctx.provide(name, value)` / `ctx.get(name)` per `vendor/cordis/src/reflect.ts:16-46`; optional services must use `ctx.get(name)`, bare property reads throw. KOL-Hunter's `apply` wraps everything in try/catch because a throwing plugin `apply` breaks the whole web shell startup.
- `DeepResearchClientContext.provide` is undeclared, so `index.ts` uses a `typeof (ctx as Record<string, unknown>)['provide'] === 'function'` guard + cast — consider adding `provide` to the interface for type honesty.
- Verification evidence so far: `pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-deepresearch test` → 6 files / **52 tests passed** (Duration ~1.8s); `pnpm --filter dsh-newapp-local test` → 16 files / **182 tests passed**. No `gate` run yet.
- Language convention: replies in Chinese; code, paths, config keys, framework/library names stay in English. Report only 结论 → 实际改动 → 原因 → 验证证据（真实命令与读数）→ 未完成项与残余风险.

## Key Technical Concepts
- DSH Desktop (DeepSeek Harness) 二开平台; repo root `/Users/lute/project/Magpie-Horch`.
- Slot injection model: `sidebar.footer.action` (official bottom slot), `shell.overlay` (global overlay).
- Plugin groups: `capabilities/` `surfaces/` `platform/` `contract/` `infra/` (ADR-0011).
- Product form contract: one `product.json` declaration + one implementation package; top-level shape always `{ "schemaVersion": 1, "products": [ … ] }`; `preset` is **required** and must be an installed `agt-*` preset (ADR-0033).
- `dsh-newapp-local` drawer discovers products by **scanning disk roots** configured via plugin config `productRoots` (parent directories, default `[]` = scan nothing); `GET /api/dsh-newapp/products`.
- Card key = `<dir>::<product id>`; one product = one card (ADR-0045 R4).
- `planOpen()` in `dsh-newapp-local` has 3 levels: level 1 = `panel` when `product.service !== '' && serviceRegistered`; level 2 = new session on declared preset; level 3 = `disabled` (`no-preset` / `no-preset-installed`).
- `launcher.isRegistered(name)` is implemented as `lookup(context, service) !== undefined`; `lookup` uses `ctx.get(name)` guarded by try/catch (bare property reads throw `cannot get property "x" without inject`).
- Level-1 open calls `open.call(service, { product: declaration, feature: entryFeature, dir })`, peeling nested `.declaration` up to depth 3.
- Local external-product assembly goes through profile `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (ADR-0061); external products must NOT be baked into shipping presets (`PRODUCT_MOUNTS` stays empty, ADR-0056).
- Gate contract: `pnpm run gate` (pre-commit) / `pnpm run gate:full` (pre-push); exit code is the contract; exemptions live in `scripts/gates/exemptions.json` (only-decreasing, ADR-0014).
- `sidebar.footer.action` rows (深度研究/知识库/设置) go through the official slot, handled by geometry-probe/sidebar-ax-probe, **not** the nav-axis REGISTRY in `scripts/gates/sidebar-row-axis.mjs`.
- Non-mechanical changes require a decision Note under `docs/notes/{lifecycle}/{class}/yyyy-mm-dd-topic.md` with `## Problem` / `## Decision` / `## Alternatives considered` / `## Consequences`, plus an ADR entry (ADR-0015).
- Red lines: credentials only in DSH credential service; never edit `app.asar`; do not touch shadows-shipped-ui slot; editor tools break `file:` hardlinks (use tmp+mv); no pinning hashes on official UI anchors.

- **Hard constraint from the user:** this is a front-end button migration only — 不要影响该功能的使用 (the research capability and overlay must keep working; do not break or reimplement the research pipeline).
- `productRoots` already includes `/Users/lute/project` in `/Users/lute/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`, so no config edit is needed for discovery of `/Users/lute/project/DeepResearch`.
- `preset: "agt-001"` was chosen because it is an actually installed preset (present in `/Users/lute/.dsh/.agent-presets/`); if the intent is a research-specific role, revisit which `agt-*` fits — an uninstalled preset makes `planOpen()` return level-3 `disabled:no-preset-installed`.
